basics.name: Oscar Nevarez
basics.label: Builder · AI agents, native apps and cloud platforms
basics.summary: I've been shipping software for 20+ years, from serverless platforms and data pipelines to a native screen recorder and AI agents that run inside real operations. Most recently I led the team at Kamina GO (Grupo Traxión) that put AI document intelligence and an internal LLM agent into a business moving 5,000+ loads a day. Before that I was CTO at Prixz. These days I build with MCP servers, Claude Code plugins, computer-use and voice agents, Rust and Tauri.

x-builder.headline: I build things that ship.
x-builder.subhead: AI agents in production, native desktop apps, and the cloud plumbing underneath them.
now: Nullcolor: native screen and webcam recorder for macOS and Windows

projects.name: Nullcolor
projects.description: Native macOS and Windows app that records screen and webcam together, with a built-in editor, 4K/60 MP4 export and a searchable recording library. Free for individuals, $99 commercial licence.

projects.name: Kineto
projects.description: The composition engine inside Nullcolor, open-sourced. A cross-platform Rust binary that gives a screen recording a cinematic treatment (background, padding, rounded corners, shadow, eased auto-zoom) on static FFmpeg, libx264 and libx265.

projects.name: So Record
projects.description: Claude Code plugin that records Playwright browser sessions and renders them as cinematic videos, with a Rust session engine and a native exporter.

projects.name: Smart Document Router
projects.description: Serverless classify, extract, embed and route pipeline for documents, with RAG chat on top.

projects.name: gh-cms
projects.description: A headless CMS where every GitHub Issue becomes a post, published with Hugo and GitHub Actions.

projects.name: q-web
projects.description: A web interface for the Q CLI that keeps PTY processes alive and streams input and output to the browser.

projects.name: Laraboot
projects.description: Buildpack-based toolchain for bootstrapping Laravel applications.

work.name: Kamina GO (Grupo Traxión)
work.summary: Freight marketplace and execution platform inside one of Mexico's largest logistics groups, running 5,000+ movements a day.
highlights: Mobile proof-of-delivery capture with OCR and AI contextual extraction, feeding invoicing, reconciliation and payment follow-up.
Per-document model routing for varied POD and evidence layouts.
Multimedia evidence system that interprets audio, video and images with AI and feeds downstream systems.
Internal AI agent across datasets and APIs, used from Slack.
Multi-tenant analytics on Athena and Metabase.

work.name: Prixz
work.summary: Mexico's first native online pharmacy: dark-store fulfilment, own site and app, plus Amazon and Mercado Libre storefronts.
highlights: Led engineering through the move from last-mile delivery provider to digital pharmacy.

work.name: ONE VAREZ
work.summary: 100+ client projects across software, data and AI.
highlights: Serverless and container platforms with CDK, CloudFormation and buildpacks.
Data and document pipelines, from crawlers to extraction and analytics.
